findings.quote: as one stderr line, `<tool>: could-not-evaluate: cannot create clone scratch under the scratch root: TMPDIR is not a usable directory: '<value>' (could-not-evaluate)`, exit 2
findings.why: The quoted byte-shape names a tool token that three of the nine modes the same sentence says were measured do not print. Measured at C0's tools with TMPDIR set to a nonexistent path: `bash-witness-study selftest` prints `WITNESS_STUDY: could-not-evaluate: ...` (`tools/bash-witness-study.py:1789`), and both `env-diff --selftest` and `env-diff --contract` print `ENVDIFF_SETUP: could-not-evaluate: ...` (`tools/env-diff.py:235,264`); all three exit 2 with exactly one stderr line, so the class half of the rule holds but the `<tool>` half does not. A reader/caller that parses the line by prefix (the shape the sentence and the frozen note `corpus/knowledge/scratch-root-contract.md` 'One line, every mode' both quote) therefore breaks on these three modes. The round-55 C2 counter cannot see it: GRAMMAR's leading token class `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*` accepts any identifier (both `WITNESS_STUDY` and `ENVDIFF_SETUP` match it, checked with the counter's own regex), and MARKER compares only the tail from `could-not-evaluate:` on. The seven registry `scratch_root` cells repeat the error more specifically: the cells for `bash-witness-study.py` and `env-diff.py` name `.py` prefixes that neither tool ever prints, yet the counter's docs arm reads 7/7. Fix: either say the leading token is a fixed program tag (not always the tool) or make the two tools print their own name; if a prefix parse is intended, the registry cells and the note need the same correction.

findings.quote: the dash form survives only in run artifacts and quoted text of rounds 37-52, not as a live convention
findings.why: The clause's end boundary is stale at the candidate revision: it merges two ranges that measure differently (run-artifact dash trees end at round 47, the page's own dash-form wording ran through round 52), and at C0 both halves have objects past 52. At C0 the dash form survives past 52 in two independent objects: (1) a live dash-form seat tree created in round 55 under the default base, `/fast/scratch/hyaku/tameshi-r55-noHarmC2/`, recorded in this round's own w1 report `.ufo/waves/round-55/w1/T55W1ExecNoHarm.md:189-190` ('I re-rooted later scratch at `/fast/scratch/hyaku/tameshi-r55-noHarmC2/` and removed it on completion') - a live tree, not a quotation, three rounds after the stated boundary; and (2) a round-53 artifact still carrying the dash-form sentence verbatim, `.ufo/evidence/round-53/assimilation/validate/SKILL.md:25`, which is quoted text outside 37-52. Census at C0 (`git grep -o -E '(hyaku/|(var/)?tmp/)tameshi-r[0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_]+' 9cf0146b -- .`): default-base dash form per round = 25,27,29,31-36 and 1 at round 55; `/tmp`+`/var/tmp` dash trees = rounds 37-47 only (3722 occurrences), 0 at 48-52; slash form 48-52 = 8183. The 'not as a live convention' half is weakened rather than refuted (one seat's incident re-root is not a round-wide convention), but the round range is falsified as written.
